subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Kumusta RECIPIENT_NAME,
Balik-tanaw lang sa una kong sulat tungkol sa paglago ng completed application para sa job marketplace ninyo sa Pilipinas. Ang isang puntong ulitin ko: nag-o-optimize kami patungo sa completed application, ang naisumiteng buong porma, at vina-validate namin ito sa pamamagitan ng S2S postback mula sa inyong system pagkatapos pumasa sa fraud screening. Sa aming saklaw ay umaabot ito ng 4,200 completed application bawat araw, isang ilustratibong pamantayan. Kung makakatulong, ipapadala ko ang application view ayon sa job category. Mag-uusap kaya tayo nang maikli?
illustrative_flags: 4,200 completed application bawat araw (4,200 completed applications a day) - MobUpps illustrative daily volume, not an established result
register_notes: Stage 1 tl jobs_recruitment CPS: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (optimize to completed application + S2S postback validation + fraud screening); one illustrative figure (4,200/day, flagged inline and in illustrative_flags); native Tagalog business register, neutral 'Kumusta' with RECIPIENT_NAME slot preserved; soft CTA, exactly one question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y'.
